method: Five whole pinned files read;19 original UnionFind test methods executed directly against original UnionFind. Original timer classes AST-extracted with local Progress/clock/logger doubles; injected exception and empty/zero reports.
findings: All19UnionFind test methods pass locally. Covers rank, path compression, reset, disjoint components and100-element chain; does not establish semantic validity of dedup component merging.

TimerContext.__exit__ raises received exception before spinner.stop and elapsed recording. Original-class control confirms started spinner remains unstopped and failed phase unrecorded. Real rich terminal behavior untested.

Timer.report on empty elapsed_times raises ValueError from max(empty); zero-duration non-total phase raises ZeroDivisionError while formatting percentages. Both reproduced with original method bodies.

Timer total is sum of all named non-total measurements, which can double-count nested phases; elapsed dictionary overwrites repeated phase names. Runtime timing interpretation requires explicit nesting/repetition contract.

CustomProgressBar tracks initial progress and guards update before task creation. Context managers patch two datasets progress globals under with, so patch restoration follows context exit; parallel/nested framework compatibility untested.

Logger configures root basicConfig at ERROR and sets text_dedup logger DEBUG; this is global logging setup, not per-run configuration. env helper logs Polars pool, CPU and available memory; no environment validation/constraint enforcement in that helper.

result.scope: Original UnionFind test bodies; original timer classes with local Progress/clock/logger doubles. No rich rendering/full pytest.

limits: No full pytest, actual rich rendering/datasets monkeypatch integration, or production changes. pHash/ASAN deferred.
